ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15% high-intensity (white/light-gray) markings, creating a high-contrast macro-level distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigment base. High-contrast white markings are distributed as linear streaks and circular clusters across both lobes. A localized mid-intensity gray polygon is visible on the upper-right lobe near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute angle of approximately 35-40 degrees and a defined vertex at the fluke junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged peaks along the entire trailing edge; serrations appear more pronounced and irregular on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the outer margins of both lobes, tapering to sharp, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-like high-contrast white pixel clusters (barnacle scars) distributed primarily in the central and mid-left regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear streaks (rake marks) crossing both lobes at various angles, with a dense parallel cluster visible on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, ragged topography at both distal tips indicating tissue erosion; significant concentration of linear and circular scarring across approximately 60% of the visible surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive large, isolated gray pigment patch on the superior margin of the right fluke lobe, differentiated from the surrounding dark pigment and white scarring.
